title: 发现重大数学猜想的LLM框架：AI对下一个黎曼猜想的探索
summary: 提出一个三阶段流水线，用于系统生成和验证重大数学猜想：区域搜索、反思性验证和Lean 4形式化验证。实验显示20个候选全部通过Lean解析和类型检查，未被现有策略自动解决，且无重复。旨在发现具有高问题品味、能重组研究领域语言的问题。
summary_en: Presents a three-stage pipeline for systematic generation and validation of major mathematical conjectures: region search, reflective validation, and formal validation in Lean 4. Experiments show 20/20 candidates pass parsing and type checking, none auto-discharged, no duplicates. Aims to discover problems with high problem taste.
